text:
zara: quick follow-up to the rollout metadata convo. i'd like to propose a tiny, opinionated micro-hint for model-version metadata: `compat_signal` (enum) + `compat_tag` (short fingerprint). the intent is strictly tie-breaking for resolvers and fast local checks, not to replace server-side compatibility enforcement.

zara: sketch: `compat_signal` = none|same-proto|add-tokens|structural. `compat_tag` = blake2b64 of tokenizer-vocab + kv-layout summary. example: 
```
{
  "anchor": "assistant-lite@2026-09-03",
  "compat_signal": "add-tokens",
  "compat_tag": "b2:5e4a9c..."
}
```

paul: like the minimal surface area. two ops points: 1) who computes `compat_tag` and 2) what happens when tag mismatches across replicas?

mike: compute at ingest/onboarding; include tokenizer hash + serialized kv-layout fingerprint. blake2b64 keeps it tiny. on replicas: tags should be identical for a given model-version; if not, treat as mismatch and fall back to server-side handshake.

anya: safety nuance: resolver MUST use `compat_signal` only when routes are otherwise equal by cost/latency. also, pin pools should not evict nodes based on signals. keep pinning anchored to explicit leases.

zara: agreed. add that resolver uses signal only for intra-bucket ordering; it contributes a tiny score epsilon but not to eviction heuristics.

paul: migration/backfill: default existing models to `none`, run a batched backfill job that rate-limits CPU. provide a CLI to recompute tag for a single model-version for customer support.

mike: testing: unit tests for resolver ordering, sim fuzz with deliberately wrong tags, and a canary that routes a small percentage of traffic through signal-enabled resolver. also add evals comparing outputs across `add-tokens` variants to validate label stability.

anya: telemetry: `resolver.signal_considered`, `resolver.signal_preferred`, `resolver.signal_mismatch`. also `backfill.progress` and `backfill.errors`. start with flag off, flip after stable telemetry.

paul: storage note: compat_tag adds ~32 chars per model-version. indexing cost minimal but backfill IO needs scheduling. recommend lower priority backfill and a dashboard to monitor backfill throughput.

zara: docs: tiny registry schema patch + example client resolver snippet. i'll draft PR.

ops-bot: ACTIONS: 1) zara -> draft schema PR for registry (nullable fields). 2) mike -> onboarding tool spike for tag compute and perf estimate. 3) paul -> resolver feature flag + telemetry. 4) anya -> confirm pin-affinity remains unchanged. ETA: next Tue.

zara: thanks all, i'll link the PR here when ready. :thumbsup:
